Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1124
Claimant:
Kevin Mayer
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
11/02/2023
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a vehicle that backed out of a
space. The claimant, who is not represented by counsel, reported neck pain and was advised on the next steps for
medical evaluation.
11/26/2023
Spoke with the claimant by phone to confirm the sequence of events, and the account given matched the first report
in every detail. The claimant described the impact as a rear-end contact at low speed with a sudden jolt forward and
back.
12/12/2023
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision and records the
location and the parties involved. Two independent witnesses also confirmed the claimant was seated in the car when
it was struck.
01/04/2024
Received photographs of the vehicle damage from both drivers. The damage to the rear bumper and tail light is
consistent with the impact described and with the speed reported.
01/19/2024
Contacted the other driver, who confirmed the accident happened as the claimant described. The other driver's
statement was taken and filed with the claim.
03/04/2024
Inspected the vehicle and noted a few old scratches on the lower panel. These may predate this collision, so they
have been marked separately from the new damage for the repair estimate.
03/09/2024
Reviewed the medical records, which show whiplash-type symptoms that fit the kind and force of this impact. The
treating provider followed a usual course of care for this type of injury.
03/18/2024
Claimant reported that a small strain in the same area of the neck occurred several years ago and healed completely
with no lasting limits. The prior history has been noted in the file, and the treating provider was aware of it.
04/03/2024
Checked the policy records and confirmed the policy was active at the time of the loss. Nothing in the file suggests
the damage occurred before the coverage start date.
05/13/2024
Confirmed the driver of the insured vehicle lives in the policyholder's household and is covered as a resident family
member under the policy terms.
05/20/2024
Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, and the most recent update from the provider describes steady
recovery with fewer visits scheduled. No further treatment requests have been received at this time.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
